periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation slanting downwards toward the snout at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape where the vertical height of the patch is significantly greater than its horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward taper, with the centroid shifted toward the upper-middle section and the lowest point extending toward the jawline.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Relatively straight posterior edge with minimal curvature, exhibiting a flat U-shaped profile across the dorsal surface.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The visible left ear exhibits a smooth, semi-circular rounded apex with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, irregular dark-colored patch or staining present on the posterior lateral flank/hip region, separate from the primary dorsal band.
